patch_name: ISL Phase 10B Hidden Return Lifecycle Fix v3
purpose: Keep hidden-background lifecycle observation active until visible return and require a complete, uncensored >=1500 ms hidden interval that began during playback.
notes: Old hidden_background 3/6 captures are not reusable under the new closed-interval rule.
A complete visible_unfocused pass may be reused because its condition semantics are unchanged.
The previous foreground_focused 6/6 pass remains reusable.
